name: create users and a group for posix access control
definition: add named OS users and a group so that permission delegation can be tested by running commands under those identities.
failure_mode: missing identities make the verifier's identity-based invocations fail at the first step

name: cross-check financial figures to detect a single inconsistent value
definition: Compare the derived/related figures to locate the one financially inconsistent metric.
failure_mode: pointing at the wrong metric yields the wrong value
